The two context shots are both wrong: the website shot shows a campaign poster, the IG shot shows an error page (not queued or documented). site-01.webp is a generic stock meeting photo, not website design work. site-07 and site-08 are duplicate kitchen photos. The WMP images show only physical neon sign photography with no web/digital work visible. The scraper must: (1) retake the website context shot; (2) handle the IG context shot via the sanctioned queued path or a fresh attempt; (3) replace site-01 with an actual Born Ugly website design image; (4) deduplicate site-07/08; (5) add web-facing images for the WMP project; (6) delete the orphan files and reconcile the manifest; (7) set Autonomy with reasoning.
